title: Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreements: A Geometric Perspective

described.name: Two-Stage GBALD Active Learning Framework
described.text: Active learning framework that addresses BALD's sensitivity to uninformative priors via initial core-set acquisitions and prevents redundant information via representativeness-constrained uncertainty ranking.

described.name: Ellipsoid Geodesic Core-set Construction
described.text: Core-set construction strategy that rescales spherical geodesic updates into an ellipsoid using affine factor eta, preventing core-set elements from falling into low-representative boundary regions.
